tasks.label: Commit all cleaned changes
tasks.command: & 'C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe' add -A; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & 'C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe' commit -m "Remove Unreal workflow and consolidate Blender pipeline" -m "Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>"

tasks.label: Create cleaned commit
tasks.command: $trailer = 'Co-authored-by: Copilot ' + [char]60 + '223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com' + [char]62; & 'C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe' add -A; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & 'C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe' commit -m 'Remove Unreal workflow and consolidate Blender pipeline' -m $trailer
